A new order comes in for 22 luxury watches. If the work continues at the same rate, how many weeks will it take Hermione to complete the luxury watches?
solution: First, find Hermione's rate per item. Hermione made 5 luxury watches in 18 weeks, so each item takes $18 \div 5 = 3.6$ weeks.
Now find how long it takes to make 22 luxury watches. Since each item takes 3.6 weeks, multiply: $3.6 \times 22 = 79$ weeks.
Therefore, it will take Hermione 79 weeks to complete 22 luxury watches.

quizzes.question_text: Senku works as a fishmonger creating sushi-grade fish. Recently, Senku completed 4 sushi-grade fish in 43 weeks. Now there's an order for 41 sushi-grade fish. Working at the same pace, how many weeks will Senku need to finish the sushi-grade fish?
solution: First, find Senku's rate per item. Senku made 4 sushi-grade fish in 43 weeks, so each item takes $43 \div 4 = 10.75$ weeks.
Now find how long it takes to make 41 sushi-grade fish. Since each item takes 10.75 weeks, multiply: $10.75 \times 41 = 440$ weeks.
Therefore, it will take Senku 440 weeks to complete 41 sushi-grade fish.
